page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6.13xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 52 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CL processors. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 14.77 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. It lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. Networking capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

The high memory density relative to the vCPU count positions this instance for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. It is designed for large-scale in-memory databases, caching layers, and complex data processing tasks where memory capacity is the primary bottleneck rather than raw compute or local disk I/O.
